title: Platform Handoff
description: Structured target infrastructure mappings provided by the platform operator persona, consumed by application migration tools.

target_project.description: Target Google Cloud Project ID hosting GKE clusters.

workload_identity_pool.description: Google Cloud Workload Identity pool URL (e.g. PROJECT_ID.svc.id.goog).

registry_endpoint.description: Target Artifact Registry Docker repository URL.

storage_class_map.description: Key-value mapping of EKS StorageClass names to GKE StorageClass names.

identity_map.description: Key-value mapping of AWS IRSA Role ARNs to target GSA emails.

clusters.description: List of target GKE clusters in scope.

location.description: Google Cloud region or zone where cluster is located.

mode.description: Operational mode of the target GKE cluster.
